objective.en: Put drawings of daily routines in order and sort them into morning, afternoon and night.
objective.id: Mengurutkan gambar kegiatan sehari-hari dan memilahnya ke pagi, siang, dan malam.

materials.en: Six small drawings or photos of your child's routines (waking up, breakfast, school or play, lunch, bath, bedtime)
materials.id: Enam gambar kecil atau foto kegiatan anak (bangun, sarapan, sekolah atau bermain, makan siang, mandi, tidur)

preparation.en: Make the six cards together if you like; children love drawing their own day.
preparation.id: Buat keenam kartu bersama jika mau; anak senang menggambar harinya sendiri.

steps.en: Mix the cards. Ask: 'What do you do first when you wake up?'
steps.id: Acak kartunya. Tanyakan: 'Apa yang kamu lakukan pertama saat bangun?'

steps.en: Let your child line up the whole day.
Place the three labels and sort the cards under them.
steps.id: Letakkan ketiga label dan pilah kartu di bawahnya.

adultWording.en: What happens before lunch? After your bath?
adultWording.id: Apa yang terjadi sebelum makan siang? Setelah mandi?

cleanup.en: Keep the cards on the fridge as a picture timetable.
cleanup.id: Tempel kartu di kulkas sebagai jadwal bergambar.

variations.en: Add a clock face to the morning and night cards.
variations.id: Tambahkan gambar jam pada kartu pagi dan malam.

safetyNotes.en: An adult stays within reach for the whole activity.
safetyNotes.id: Orang dewasa tetap dalam jangkauan selama kegiatan.

safetyNotes.en: Stop whenever your child loses interest. Try again another day.
safetyNotes.id: Berhenti kapan pun anak kehilangan minat. Coba lagi di hari lain.

parentNotes.en: Time words are abstract; linking them to the child's own routine makes them concrete.
parentNotes.id: Kata waktu itu abstrak; mengaitkannya dengan kegiatan anak sendiri membuatnya konkret.
